metadata.description: Bundled illustrative destination catalog for Personalized Travel Itinerary Planner.
metadata.disclaimer: All attractions, indicative costs, visit durations, and meal recommendations are illustrative guidelines. Operating hours, seasonal availability, and ticket prices must be verified before travel.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.tagline: The Historic Pink City of Forts and Palaces
destinations.description: Known for its royal palaces, imposing hill forts, vibrant bazaars, and rich Rajputana architecture in terracota-pink stone.
destinations.climate_summary: Warm semi-arid climate; best visited between October and March.

attractions.name: Amber Fort and Palace
attractions.description: Majestic hilltop fortress overlooking Maota Lake with grand courtyards and intricate Sheesh Mahal mirror work.
attractions.practical_tips: Climb early in the morning to beat the heat; composite tourist ticket available.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
attractions.description: Five-storey honeycomb pink-sandstone facade with 953 jharokhas built for royal women to observe street processions.
attractions.practical_tips: Best facade photography from the rooftop cafes directly opposite.

attractions.name: City Palace & Museum
attractions.description: Royal residence blending Rajput and Mughal architecture, housing royal costumes, weaponry, and manuscripts.
attractions.practical_tips: Audio guides provide deep historical context on the Kachwaha dynasty.

attractions.name: Jantar Mantar Astronomical Observatory
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage site featuring 19 monumental stone architectural instruments built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II.
attractions.practical_tips: Hire an authorized guide or use the audio guide to comprehend the sundial geometry.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort Sunset Viewpoint
attractions.description: Ridgetop fortress along the Aravalli hills delivering panoramic sunset views of the entire illuminated Pink City.
attractions.practical_tips: Book cabs with return wait time included; mountain road has limited night transit.

attractions.name: Johari Bazaar & Bapu Bazaar Walk
attractions.description: Historic lanes famous for traditional gemstones, handmade bandhani textiles, lac bangles, and blue pottery.
attractions.practical_tips: Polite bargaining is customary; look for authentic handicrafts board certifications.

attractions.name: Chokhi Dhani Cultural Village
attractions.description: Immersive cultural resort with traditional Rajasthani folk dances, puppet shows, camel rides, and thali dining.
attractions.practical_tips: Located on Tonk Road; plan arrival by 6:30 PM for all live stage performances.

attractions.name: Jal Mahal Promenade & Photography
attractions.description: Serene 18th-century submerged palace floating in Man Sagar Lake against the backdrop of the rugged Aravalli range.
attractions.practical_tips: Interior entry restricted; promenade viewing is picturesque during early sunrise.

breakfast.name: Pyaaz Kachori & Jalebi at Rawat Mishthan Bhandar
Masala Poha & Kulhad Chai
Continental Fruit Platter & Fresh Mint Parathas

lunch.name: Authentic Rajasthani Dal Baati Churma Thali
Ker Sangri, Bajre ki Roti, & Gatte ki Sabzi
Laal Maas with Roomali Roti (Non-Veg Heritage Dining)

dinner.name: Grand Royal Thali at Traditional Dining Hall
Rooftop Dining overlooking Illuminated Hawa Mahal
Tandoori Vegetable Platter & Yellow Dal Tadka

destinations.transport_tips: Auto-rickshaws and app-based cabs (Uber/Ola) are widely available. An E-rickshaw is ideal for navigating the walled old city.
destinations.notes: Modest clothing recommended when visiting temples and active shrines. Keep footwear easy to slip off.

destinations.name: Udaipur
destinations.tagline: The Romantic Venice of the East and City of Lakes
destinations.description: Famed for tranquil artificial lakes, marble palaces, ghats, luxury havelis, and stunning Aravalli mountain backdrops.
destinations.climate_summary: Pleasant winters and moderate monsoons; peak season October through March.

attractions.name: City Palace Complex & Museum
attractions.description: Vast palatial complex overlooking Lake Pichola with ornate mirror galleries, peacocks mosaics, and royal courtyards.
attractions.practical_tips: Entry tickets separate for museum and boat rides; wear walking shoes.

attractions.name: Lake Pichola Sunset Boat Cruise
attractions.description: Scenic boat journey passing the Lake Palace (Taj Lake Palace) and stopping at Jag Mandir island palace.
attractions.practical_tips: Sunset slots sell out early; book on arrival at Rameshwar Ghat.

attractions.name: Saheliyon-ki-Bari (Courtyard of Maidens)
attractions.description: Historic royal gardens featuring marble fountains, lotus pools, rose beds, and lush shady pavilions.
attractions.practical_tips: Fountains operate through natural gravity pressure from Fateh Sagar Lake.

attractions.name: Bagore Ki Haveli & Dharohar Dance Show
attractions.description: 18th-century waterfront mansion hosting renowned evening Rajasthani folk dance, puppet theater, and fire stunts.
attractions.practical_tips: Show starts at 7:00 PM; queue for ticket counter around 5:45 PM.

attractions.name: Fateh Sagar Lake Walk & Nehru Garden
attractions.description: Pleasant lakeside promenade with cafes, boat rides, and Nehru Park on an island in the lake center.
attractions.practical_tips: Great spot for cold coffee and street chaat along the Marine Drive of Udaipur.

attractions.name: Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace
attractions.description: High hilltop fort offering dramatic vistas of the lake basin and surrounding wildlife sanctuary.
attractions.practical_tips: Forest department shuttle vans operate from the hill base.

attractions.name: Hathi Pol Art & Handicrafts Market
attractions.description: Bustling market renowned for traditional miniature Pichwai paintings, camel leather mojris, and silver jewellery.
attractions.practical_tips: Meet local master artisans directly in lanes behind the main gate.

breakfast.name: Poha with Sev, Jalebi, & Masala Tea at Sukhadia Circle
Fresh Fruit Bowl, Sprouts & Vegan Chai
Classic Continental & Masala Omelette

lunch.name: Mewari Gatte ka Saag with Bajra Rotla and Chutney
Dal Tadka, Steamed Rice, & Baingan Bharta
Lakeside Fish Curry & Rice / Safed Maas

dinner.name: Romantic Rooftop Candlelight Dinner overlooking Lake Pichola
Wood-fired Flatbreads, Hummus & Vegetable Curries
Mughlai Kebab Platter & Biryani at Ambrai Ghat

destinations.transport_tips: The old city roads are narrow; walking and two-wheelers or autorickshaws are vastly better than four-wheelers.
destinations.notes: Always respect photography rules inside royal museum enclosures.

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.tagline: Sun-kissed Beaches, Portuguese Heritage, and Coastal Vibes
destinations.description: India's premier coastal escape combining golden sand shores, UNESCO colonial churches, spice farms, and vibrant seafood culture.
destinations.climate_summary: Tropical maritime; warm and sunny from November to April, lush monsoon from June to September.

attractions.name: Fort Aguada & Historic Lighthouse
attractions.description: Well-preserved 17th-century Portuguese fortress overlooking Sinquerim beach and the vast Arabian Sea.
attractions.practical_tips: Lower fort and upper fort lighthouse area have separate entry gates.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus & Old Goa Churches
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Baroque landmark housing the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier, alongside Se Cathedral.
attractions.practical_tips: Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is mandatory for cathedral entry.

attractions.name: Anjuna & Vagator Coastal Cliffs
attractions.description: Red laterite cliffs, swaying palm groves, beach shacks, and chilled-out music vibes beside the Arabian Sea.
attractions.practical_tips: Wednesday flea market at Anjuna has artisanal jewelry, clothes, and souvenirs.

attractions.name: Water Sports at Calangute & Baga Beach
attractions.description: Parasailing, jet skiing, banana boat rides, and bumper rides supervised by certified coastal operators.
attractions.practical_tips: Wear life jackets at all times; prices fluctuate with seasonal demand.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls Day Excursion
attractions.description: Four-tiered majestic 310m waterfall on Mandovi river reached via rugged forest jeep safari through Bhagwan Mahavir Sanctuary.
attractions.practical_tips: Book government registered jeep slots early; swimming requires mandatory life jacket.

attractions.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Heritage Walk
attractions.description: Charming colonial Portuguese quarter in Panaji with narrow pastel-colored streets, wooden balconies, and boutique art cafes.
attractions.practical_tips: Early morning or late afternoon yields soft natural light for photography.

attractions.name: Sunset Mandovi River Cruise
attractions.description: One-hour scenic river cruise featuring live Goan Dekhni and Fugdi folk dance performances and DJ music.
attractions.practical_tips: Cruises depart from Santa Monica Jetty in Panaji; reach 30 minutes before boarding.

breakfast.name: Poi Bread with Mushroom Xacuti & Kokum Juice
Fresh Tropical Fruit Bowl & Coconut Milk Smoothie
Traditional Goan Chorizo Pao & Egg Omelette

lunch.name: Goan Vegetarian Thali with Vegetable Caldin & Sol Kadi
Coconut Veggie Stew, Brown Rice & Fried Raw Banana
Goan Fish Curry Thali (Kingfish/Pomfret) with Rice

dinner.name: Grilled Paneer Peri-Peri at Sunset Beach Shack
Stir-fried Asian Vegetables, Rice Noodles, and Cashew Curry
Prawn Balchao, Crab Xec Xec & Garlic Pao by the Sea

destinations.transport_tips: Self-drive scooters (scotty) and self-drive cars are the most flexible and economical way to travel around Goa.
destinations.notes: Always swim only in designated safe zones monitored by lifeguards; strictly heed colored safety flags.

destinations.name: Mumbai
destinations.tagline: The City of Dreams, Colonial Heritage, and Marine Vistas
destinations.description: India's commercial and cinematic powerhouse, celebrated for Victorian gothic architecture, seaside promenades, and vibrant street life.
destinations.climate_summary: Tropical wet and dry; cooler and dry between November and February.

attractions.name: Gateway of India & Taj Mahal Palace Hotel
attractions.description: Iconic 26m basalt archway on the waterfront erected to commemorate King George V, flanked by the historic Taj Mahal Palace.
attractions.practical_tips: Visit at sunrise to see fishing boats and avoid the bustling midday crowds.

attractions.name: Elephanta Caves Island Excursion
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage rock-cut cave temples dating to 5th-7th century CE featuring the monumental 3-headed Sadashiva sculpture.
attractions.practical_tips: Ferries leave regularly from Gateway of India; caves are closed on Mondays.

attractions.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CST)
attractions.description: Magnificent Victorian Gothic revival railway terminus and UNESCO site with ornate gargoyles, stained glass, and stone domes.
attractions.practical_tips: Illuminated with colorful architectural floodlights every evening after 7 PM.

attractions.name: Marine Drive (Queen's Necklace) Promenade
attractions.description: 3.6-kilometer C-shaped boulevard along Back Bay offering refreshing sea breezes and skyline views.
attractions.practical_tips: Ideal for an evening stroll followed by street food at Girgaon Chowpatty.

attractions.name: Colaba Causeway Street Shopping & Cafes
attractions.description: High-energy street market with antiques, junk jewelry, brass artifacts, bookstalls, and legendary heritage cafes.
attractions.practical_tips: Stop by Leopold Cafe or Cafe Mondegar for heritage ambiance.

attractions.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya
attractions.description: Leading arts and natural history museum housed in an Indo-Saracenic mansion set in manicured palm gardens.
attractions.practical_tips: Extensive miniature painting, numismatic, and archaeological galleries.

attractions.name: Bandra Fort & Bandra-Worli Sea Link View
attractions.description: Remnants of Castella de Aguada offering scenic vantage points of the magnificent cable-stayed bridge and Arabian waves.
attractions.practical_tips: Great sunset spot; combines nicely with walking along Carter Road or Bandstand.

breakfast.name: Bun Maska & Irani Chai at B. Merwan / Yazdani Bakery
Mumbai Kanda Poha, Upma, & Filter Coffee
Akuri on Toast & Kheema Pav at Leopold Cafe

lunch.name: Traditional Gujarati / Rajasthani Thali in Kalbadevi
Pav Bhaji (vegan oil/margarine option) & Bhel Puri
Bombil Fry, Surmai Fish Curry & Neer Dosa at Mahesh Lunch Home

dinner.name: South Mumbai Street Food Crawl: Sev Puri, Pani Puri & Dosa
Dal Khichdi with Papad & Roasted Aloo Jeera
Continental & Seafood Grill at Waterfront Bandra Cafe

destinations.transport_tips: Mumbai's local train network, modern Metro lines, and meter-based black-and-yellow Kaali-Peeli taxis make getting around easy.
destinations.notes: Avoid peak rush hour local trains (8:30-10:30 AM and 5:30-8:00 PM) when traveling with family.

destinations.name: Delhi
destinations.tagline: The Historic Capital of Empires and Modern Metropolis
destinations.description: A magnificent collision of centuries-old Mughal bastions, Lutyens' colonial avenues, vibrant food bazaars, and modern urban culture.
destinations.climate_summary: Extreme continental climate; very pleasant from October to March.

attractions.name: Qutub Minar & Mehrauli Archaeological Complex
attractions.description: 73m soaring red sandstone minaret built in 1192, featuring intricate inscriptions and the mysterious rust-resistant Iron Pillar.
attractions.practical_tips: Book online tickets on the ASI portal for expedited turnstile entry.

attractions.name: Humayun's Tomb & Sunder Nursery
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage garden tomb that served as the architectural precursor to the Taj Mahal, set in restored Persian Charbagh.
attractions.practical_tips: Combine with adjoining Sunder Nursery gardens for a peaceful nature walk.

attractions.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
attractions.description: Historic seat of Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan with octagonal towers, Diwan-i-Aam, and marble Diwan-i-Khas.
attractions.practical_tips: Closed on Mondays; comprehensive museum complex located inside barracks.

attractions.name: Chandni Chowk Old Delhi Rickshaw & Food Walk
attractions.description: Bustling 17th-century market alleyways: Paranthe Wali Gali, spice scent of Khari Baoli, and Jama Masjid views.
attractions.practical_tips: Opt for cycle-rickshaws to navigate narrow galis comfortably.

attractions.name: India Gate & Kartavya Path Walk
attractions.description: 42m triumphal war memorial archway commemorating soldiers, with broad tree-lined avenues and the National War Memorial.
attractions.practical_tips: Atmosphere comes alive in the evening with ice-cream vendors and illuminated fountains.

attractions.name: Lotus Temple (Bahá'í House of Worship)
attractions.description: Spectacular pure white marble 27-petal lotus structure welcoming people of all faiths for silent meditation.
attractions.practical_tips: Complete silence is observed inside the prayer hall; closed on Mondays.

attractions.name: National Museum at Janpath
attractions.description: Premier repository of Indian antiquities spanning Harappan civilization relics, Buddhist art, and Mughal miniatures.
attractions.practical_tips: The Harappan gallery features the famous Dancing Girl bronze sculpture.

attractions.name: Dilli Haat INA Crafts & Food Stalls
attractions.description: Open-air thatched craft bazaar showcasing authentic regional artisans and cuisine counters from every Indian state.
attractions.practical_tips: Fixed reasonable ticket entry keeps crowds orderly; excellent regional food stalls.

breakfast.name: Chole Bhature with Pickled Carrots at Sita Ram Diwan Chand
Bedmi Puri & Spicy Aloo Sabzi in Chandni Chowk
Egg Bhurji & Butter Toast at Pandara Road

lunch.name: Kadhi Pakora, Jeera Rice, & Sarson Ka Saag with Makki Roti
Rajma Chawal, Mint Chutney, & Onion Salad
Mughlai Butter Chicken & Mutton Seekh Kebab at Karim's

dinner.name: Dal Makhani, Shahi Paneer, & Garlic Naan at Gulati / Pandara Road
Tandoori Soya Chaap, Roti, and Dal Tadka
Chicken Tikka Platter & Biryani at Khan Market Eatery

destinations.transport_tips: Delhi Metro is world-class, fully air-conditioned, fast, and covers nearly all tourist attractions directly.
destinations.notes: Always carry a scarf/shawl for covering head in religious sites (Gurudwaras, Mosques, and Temples).

destinations.name: Varanasi
destinations.tagline: The Ancient Spiritual Heart on the Sacred River Ganga
destinations.description: One of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, renowned for ancient ghats, evocative rituals, narrow gallis, and silk weaving.
destinations.climate_summary: Hot summers; cool and peaceful spiritual atmosphere from October to March.

attractions.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat Evening Ganga Aarti
attractions.description: Mesmerizing devotional evening ritual with multi-tiered brass oil lamps, rhythmic chants, conch shells, and cymbals.
attractions.practical_tips: Rent a shared or private boat by 5:30 PM for the most spectacular riverfront view.

attractions.name: Sunrise Rowing Boat Ride along River Ghats
attractions.description: Dawn boat glide from Assi Ghat to Manikarnika Ghat witnessing early morning prayers, ablutions, and centuries-old havelis.
attractions.practical_tips: Board by 5:15-5:45 AM depending on season; negotiate price beforehand.

attractions.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple & Ganga Corridor
attractions.description: Golden spire temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, newly connected to the Ganga through a majestic pedestrian corridor.
attractions.practical_tips: Mobile phones and leather items are strictly prohibited inside; deposit at official lockers.

attractions.name: Sarnath Buddhist Archaeological Site & Dhamek Stupa
attractions.description: Where Gautama Buddha gave his first sermon; features the massive 43m Dhamek Stupa, Ashoka pillar base, and archaeological museum.
attractions.practical_tips: Located 10 km north of Varanasi; allocate 45 minutes of travel time.

attractions.name: Assi Ghat Morning Yoga & Music Walk
attractions.description: Southernmost ghat famous for morning Subah-e-Banaras music performances, open yoga sessions, and bohemian cafes.
attractions.practical_tips: Enjoy a wood-fired apple pie or herbal tea at nearby bakeries.

attractions.name: Traditional Banarasi Silk Weaving Workshop
attractions.description: Witness master weavers operating manual Jacquard looms weaving intricate gold zari Banarasi sarees and brocades.
attractions.practical_tips: Visit government-run weavers' cooperatives to guarantee handloom authenticity.

breakfast.name: Banarasi Kachori Sabzi with Jalebi at Ram Bhandar
Poha with Chura Matar & Lemon Mint Tea
Masala Omelette & Toast at Pizzeria Vaatika Cafe Assi

lunch.name: Satvik Banarasi Thali with Paneer, Dal, & Baati
Yellow Dal Tadka, Steamed Rice, Aloo Gobhi, and Phulka
Mughlai Biryani & Kebab at Nai Sarak Eatery

dinner.name: Banarasi Tamatar Chaat & Blue Lassi at Bangali Tola
Vegetable Pulao with Roasted Papad and Salad
Riverside Indian Dinner overlooking the Illuminated Ghats

destinations.transport_tips: Walking is the only feasible way inside the historic labyrinth of gallis (alleys). Use autorickshaws for distances along main avenues.
destinations.notes: Be respectful of funeral pyres and mourners at Manikarnika and Harishchandra Ghats; photography is strictly forbidden there.

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.tagline: Himalayan Valley of Gods, Pine Forests, and Alpine Adventures
destinations.description: High-altitude resort town tucked in the Beas river valley, renowned for pine forests, snow-clad peaks, and thrilling mountain sports.
destinations.climate_summary: Alpine mountain climate; snow from December to February, pleasant summer from April to June.

attractions.name: Solang Valley Adventure Arena
attractions.description: Glacial valley hub for paragliding, zorbing, ATV rides, and winter skiing with stunning views of Pir Panjal peaks.
attractions.practical_tips: Book adventure activities directly with licensed operators at government-monitored counters.

attractions.name: Atal Tunnel & Sissu Lahaul Valley Excursion
attractions.description: Drive through the 9.02km engineering marvel tunnel into the stark high-altitude desert and freezing Sissu waterfall in Lahaul.
attractions.practical_tips: Carry warm thermals and jackets; temperatures drop drastically past the North Portal.

attractions.name: Hadimba Devi Temple & Dhungri Cedar Forest
attractions.description: 16th-century four-tiered pagoda-style wooden temple dedicated to Hadimba, surrounded by towering deodar forests.
attractions.practical_tips: Quiet walks in the surrounding cedar forest are serene and great for photography.

attractions.name: Jogini Waterfall Pine Trail Trek
attractions.description: Scenic 3.5 km trail through apple orchards, small mountain streams, and pine woods leading to cascading mountain falls.
attractions.practical_tips: Wear sturdy trekking shoes with good grip; carry a reusable water bottle.

attractions.name: Old Manali Village & Bohemian Cafes
attractions.description: Quaint village with wooden Himachali homes, live acoustic music cafes, bakeries, and hippie souvenir shops.
attractions.practical_tips: Cross the Manalsu bridge on foot; parking for vehicles is virtually impossible inside.

attractions.name: Vashisht Natural Sulphur Hot Springs
attractions.description: Natural thermal hot water springs with therapeutic minerals, housed in a traditional stone temple courtyard.
attractions.practical_tips: Separate bathing sections for men and women; carry your own towel.

attractions.name: Mall Road & Tibetan Monasteries
attractions.description: Pedestrian shopping spine of Manali with woollen shawls, Kullu caps, Tibetan prayer wheels, and handicrafts.
attractions.practical_tips: Vehicles are barred on Mall Road; visit the Gadhan Thekchhokling Gompa nearby.

breakfast.name: Siddu (Steamed Himachali Walnut Bread) with Ghee
Apple Porridge & Fresh Mint Ginger Tea
Shakshuka, Hash Browns & Fresh Brewed Coffee

lunch.name: Himachali Dham (Madra, Mah ki Dal, Khatta) on Leaf Plate
Rajma Pahadi with Red Rice and Radish Chutney
Pan-fried Fresh Himalayan Trout Fish with Fries

dinner.name: Hot Vegetable Thukpa & Steamed Veg Momos
Tofu & Vegetable Stir Fry with Tibetan Tingmo Bread
Himachali Mutton Curry with Steamed Rice by Fireplace

destinations.transport_tips: Hired local taxis (managed through Manali Union rates) are standard for Atal Tunnel and Solang Valley. Walking is best for Old Manali.
destinations.notes: Check for Rohtang Pass permits in advance if planning to cross into high altitude beyond Atal Tunnel.

destinations.name: Kochi
destinations.tagline: The Queen of the Arabian Sea and Spice Coast Gateway
destinations.description: Cosmopolitan coastal harbor where Portuguese, Dutch, British, and Arab maritime histories meet tranquil Kerala backwaters.
destinations.climate_summary: Tropical humid climate; coolest and pleasant from November to February.

attractions.name: Fort Kochi Chinese Fishing Nets (Cheena Vala)
attractions.description: Centuries-old cantilevered shoreline fishing contraptions introduced by Chinese traders in the court of Kublai Khan.
attractions.practical_tips: Local fishermen demonstrate the cantilever weights during sunset; tipping is standard.

attractions.name: Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace)
attractions.description: Palace built by the Portuguese and gifted to the Raja of Kochi, celebrated for extraordinary Ramayana tempera murals.
attractions.practical_tips: Closed on Fridays; photography strictly banned in mural chambers.

attractions.name: Jew Town & Paradesi Synagogue
attractions.description: Historic synagogue founded in 1568 with hand-painted Cantonese porcelain floor tiles and Belgian glass chandeliers, surrounded by spice and antique shops.
attractions.practical_tips: Closed on Saturdays; fragrant spice warehouses line the cobblestone street.

attractions.name: Kerala Kathakali Centre Evening Performance
attractions.description: Classical Kerala dance drama featuring elaborate hand gestures (mudras), eye expressions, and live facial makeup application.
attractions.practical_tips: Arrive at 5:00 PM to watch the intricate makeup being painted before the 6:30 PM performance.

attractions.name: Kumbalangi Backwater Village Eco-Tour
attractions.description: Country boat or canoe cruise through mangrove wetlands, crab farms, and coconut palm fringed canals.
attractions.practical_tips: Experience rural coir making, traditional fishing methods, and calm water navigation.

attractions.name: St. Francis Church & Santa Cruz Cathedral
attractions.description: One of India's oldest European churches where explorer Vasco da Gama was initially buried in 1524.
attractions.practical_tips: Located in central Fort Kochi close to boutique artsy cafes.

attractions.name: Broadway & Marine Drive Kochi Walkway
attractions.description: Vibrant wholesale marketplace in mainland Ernakulam leading to the waterfront Marine Drive promenade and rainbow bridge.
attractions.practical_tips: Take the public water ferry from Fort Kochi jetty to Ernakulam for just ₹6 per person.

breakfast.name: Appam with Vegetable Stew & Fresh Coconut Milk
Steamed Puttu with Kadala Curry & Steamed Plantains
Egg Roast with Flaky Kerala Porotta

lunch.name: Traditional Kerala Sadhya Feast on Banana Leaf
Avial, Thoran, Kalan, Matta Rice & Lemon Pickle
Karimeen Pollichathu (Pearl Spot in banana leaf) with Rice

dinner.name: Dosa with Varieties of Chutney and Sambar at Pai Dosa
Coconut Rice with Vegetable Kurma & Roasted Pappadam
Malabar Pepper Chicken Curry with Malabar Porotta

destinations.transport_tips: Kochi's public Water Metro and Ro-Ro ferry services provide an enjoyable and ultra-low-cost way to travel between islands.
destinations.notes: Footwear must be removed when entering the Paradesi Synagogue and local temple compounds.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.tagline: The City of the Taj Mahal and Mughal Grandeur
destinations.description: Home to the world's most renowned monument to love, fortified imperial citadels, and timeless marble inlay craftsmanship.
destinations.climate_summary: Subtropical; best experienced during cool winter months from October to March.

attractions.name: Taj Mahal Sunrise Visit
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage ivory-white marble mausoleum built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal.
attractions.practical_tips: Closed on Fridays. Enter through East or West gates before sunrise to beat huge daytime queues.

attractions.name: Agra Fort (Lal Qila)
attractions.description: Massive 16th-century red sandstone imperial fortress housing Jahangiri Mahal, Khas Mahal, and Sheesh Mahal.
attractions.practical_tips: Stand at Musamman Burj balcony where Shah Jahan gazed at the Taj Mahal during his final years.

attractions.name: Fatehpur Sikri Imperial City & Buland Darwaza
attractions.description: Akbar's magnificent abandoned capital complex featuring Panch Mahal, Tomb of Salim Chishti, and the 54m Victory Gate.
attractions.practical_tips: Located 37 km from Agra; take an early afternoon taxi or express bus.

attractions.name: Mehtab Bagh (Moonlight Garden) Sunset View
attractions.description: Charbagh garden complex on the opposite bank of the Yamuna River, perfectly aligned with the Taj Mahal for sunset views.
attractions.practical_tips: Spectacular photography vantage without the crowds inside the main monument.

attractions.name: Tomb of I'timād-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj)
attractions.description: Exquisite jewel-box marble tomb featuring the first extensive use of pietra dura (parchin kari) floral stone inlays.
attractions.practical_tips: Much quieter and more intimate than the larger imperial complexes.

attractions.name: Sadar Bazaar & Marble Handicrafts Walk
attractions.description: Popular commercial market known for genuine leather goods, Agra petha sweet stalls, and marble inlay souvenirs.
attractions.practical_tips: Look for government handicraft emporiums to ensure genuine semiprecious stone inlays.

breakfast.name: Bedai Puri with Spicy Aloo Jhol & Fresh Jalebi
Stuffed Paratha with Mint Chutney & Tea
Eggs Florentine & Fresh Brewed Espresso

lunch.name: Mughlai Shahi Paneer, Dal Makhani, & Butter Naan
Baingan Bharta, Tandoori Roti, & Tadka Dal
Mughlai Mutton Korma & Fragrant Chicken Biryani

dinner.name: Rooftop Restaurant Dining with Taj Mahal Distant Silhouette
Vegetable Pulao, Dal Fry, and Roasted Papad
Tandoori Chicken Platter & Seekh Kebabs at Pinch of Spice

destinations.transport_tips: Battery-operated auto-rickshaws and golf carts operate in the green pollution-free buffer zone around the Taj Mahal.
destinations.notes: Tripods, lighters, chewing gum, and large backpacks are prohibited inside the Taj Mahal complex.

destinations.name: Bengaluru
destinations.tagline: The Garden City and Vibrant Silicon Hub of Innovation
destinations.description: A dynamic blend of lush botanical gardens, historical palaces, craft microbreweries, and burgeoning tech cosmopolitanism.
destinations.climate_summary: Moderate tropical savanna; pleasant year-round climate with cool evenings.

attractions.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden & Glass House
attractions.description: 240-acre botanical haven commissioned by Hyder Ali, featuring over 1,800 plant species, centuries-old trees, and London-inspired Glass House.
attractions.practical_tips: Early morning joggers enter free before 9:00 AM; visit Lalbagh rock formed 3,000 million years ago.

attractions.name: Bangalore Palace & Royal Grounds
attractions.description: 19th-century Tudor-style royal palace built by the Wadiyar dynasty featuring fortified towers, wood carvings, and hunting trophies.
attractions.practical_tips: Audio guide is included with ticket and narrated in multiple languages.

attractions.name: Cubbon Park & Vidhana Soudha Walk
attractions.description: Sprawling 300-acre green lung of the city adjacent to the monumental neo-Dravidian legislative seat of Vidhana Soudha.
attractions.practical_tips: Closed to motorized traffic on Sundays; ideal for cycling and photography.

attractions.name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
attractions.description: Two-storey teakwood palace adorned with carved pillars, arches, and balconies, representing Indo-Islamic architecture.
attractions.practical_tips: Combines easily with visiting the bustling nearby KR Flower Market.

attractions.name: National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA)
attractions.description: Heritage colonial mansion housing over 500 artworks by Raja Ravi Varma, Amrita Sher-Gil, and modern Indian masters.
attractions.practical_tips: Serene courtyard cafe set beneath magnificent banyan trees; closed on Mondays.

attractions.name: Commercial Street & Brigade Road Shopping
attractions.description: Famous shopping precincts for silk sarees, trendy apparel, spices, leather shoes, and bookstore cafes.
attractions.practical_tips: Pedestrian friendly; check out Church Street for legendary secondhand bookshops.

attractions.name: Bannerghatta Biological Park & Safari
attractions.description: Expansive wildlife sanctuary featuring an enclosed bus safari to see tigers, lions, bears, and a circular butterfly dome.
attractions.practical_tips: Located 22 km south of city center; AC safari buses recommended.

destinations.transport_tips: Namma Metro connects east-west and north-south corridors efficiently; app-based autos and cabs are ubiquitous.
destinations.notes: Plan journeys outside peak office hours (9:00-11:00 AM and 5:30-8:30 PM) to avoid road traffic.
